meta.title: 抠抠搜搜又热又显胖，大大方方自在又显瘦
meta.title_en: Tight and Stuffy, or Loose and Slim

scenes.context: 抠抠搜搜（紧身）显胖，大大方方（宽松）显瘦。同一个身材，版型不同效果完全不同。
sentences: Tight looks bigger; loose looks slimmer.
同一身材版型不同效果不同。
The same body reads differently in different cuts.
paraphrase: Tight looks bigger; loose looks slimmer.
The same body reads differently in different cuts.
scenes.speak: Tight looks bigger; loose looks slimmer. The same body reads differently in different cuts.

scenes.context: 抠抠搜搜的小圆领，露肤度低、又热，还显得脖子粗。
sentences: A small round neck shows little skin.
It feels hot and makes the neck look thick.
paraphrase: A small round neck shows little skin.
It feels hot and makes the neck look thick.
scenes.speak: A small round neck shows little skin. It feels hot and makes the neck look thick.

scenes.context: 正肩大圆领、正肩大V领、正肩方领，露肤度高、凉快又显瘦。
sentences: Structured shoulders with an open neckline breathe better.
paraphrase: Structured shoulders with an open neckline breathe better.
scenes.speak: Structured shoulders with an open neckline breathe better. More skin, cooler and slimmer.

scenes.context: 现在看着是平的，多次水洗之后就会形成鼓包或跑出来，因为上下纱向不同、缩率方向不同。
sentences: 多次水洗后会出现鼓包。
scenes.speak: Puckering appears after many washes. Different grain directions shrink differently.

scenes.context: 去选择纱向一样的，后期就不容易出现这些问题。
sentences: Choose fabric with a consistent grain.
paraphrase: Choose fabric with a consistent grain.
scenes.speak: Choose fabric with a consistent grain. Fewer problems later on.

scenes.context: 速干裤尤其适合夏天，选择透气面料穿着更舒适。
sentences: 速干裤是夏天的好选择。
Quick-dry pants are a summer pick.
paraphrase: Quick-dry pants are a summer pick.
scenes.speak: Quick-dry pants are a summer pick. Breathable fabric feels more comfortable.

scenes.context: 这种面料薄如纸，摸上去有沙沙的声音，穿着时声音明显。
sentences: The fabric is as thin as paper.
It rustles when you touch it.
paraphrase: 用as thin as paper换一种说法
The fabric is as thin as paper.
It rustles when you touch it.
scenes.speak: The fabric is as thin as paper. It rustles when you touch it.

scenes.context: 这种轻薄面料一出汗透色度就会升高，尴尬程度看图自行感受。
sentences: Once you sweat, it becomes see-through.
Look at the picture and see for yourself.
paraphrase: Once you sweat, it becomes see-through.
Look at the picture and see for yourself.
scenes.speak: Once you sweat, it becomes see-through. Look at the picture and see for yourself.

practice: 紧身显胖，宽松显瘦，怎么说？
Tight looks bigger; loose looks slimmer.
这种面料洗多了会鼓包。
This fabric puckers after many washes.
Choose fabric with a consistent grain.
Once you sweat, it becomes see-through.
pitfalls: 紧身会勾勒赘肉，宽松更有余量
检查上下纱向是否一致
纱向不同水洗后会鼓包
小圆领露肤度低又显得脖子粗
薄如纸的面料显得轻盈
